key_conclusions.wll_liberation: FAILED - w_ll controls content fidelity not style transfer
key_conclusions.alpha_optimal: alpha=0.3 is the sweet spot for LL partial stylization
key_conclusions.round4_failed_directions: w_lh/w_hl boost, two_stage, endpoint_high, lr=0.0003 all failed or neutral
key_conclusions.adain_scale_breakthrough: endpoint_adain_scale is powerful style injection lever. Monotonic trade-off: adain up boosts DINO-S/DINO-C/LPIPS but costs CLIP-S. Peak average at adain=1.5-1.6 (brk_m/brk_s, avg=0.6012). adain=2.0 breaks 0.485 ceiling (DINO-S=0.4859) but CLIP-S drops to 0.7075.
key_conclusions.adain_scale_is_inference_only: Key discovery: endpoint_adain_scale only affects inference, NOT training. All brk_a/brk_m/brk_s/brk_t/brk_r/brk_q checkpoints are IDENTICAL (same training config). Only inference-time adain_scale differs.
key_conclusions.round5_goal: Architecture liberation: 4 directions from mathematical analysis. (1) brk_u: HH head enable for brushstroke supervision; (2) brk_v: train-time AdaIN alignment to fix train-test mismatch; (3) brk_w: HF WCT for full covariance texture transfer; (4) brk_x: backbone expansion dim=96 for expressiveness. Target: DINO-S>0.49 + CLIP-S>0.72 + radar chart dominance.
